Fueling Deicing

क्रॉसफीड

A fuel system operation allowing fuel to be transferred or used from one tank to another to maintain aircraft balance or ensure engine supply.

Quick answer: A fuel system operation allowing fuel to be transferred or used from one tank to another to maintain aircraft balance or ensure engine supply.

Definition
